entryPoints.devServerLocal: BABYLON_ASSET_DIR=work/babylon-golden-map npm run dev:babylon  (port 5173 free; add --full for full-load gate)
entryPoints.devServerCdn: npm run dev:babylon  (port 5173; dev ticket rewrite + img.yuluo.site proxy; CDN throttles repeated full loads)

environmentNotes: Node 20.11.1 at E:/nodejs must be on PATH for npm lifecycle scripts (postinstall spawns cmd.exe).
The CDN only sends CORS headers for https://yuluo.site. Dev servers rewrite ticket URLs to same-origin via the middleware in vite.babylon.config.js (dev/preview only).
yuluo.site/ff14-assets/* serves the SPA, not assets; only img.yuluo.site serves versioned assets.
Repeated full-map streams over the CDN hit ECONNRESET throttling. Local mode via BABYLON_ASSET_DIR=work/babylon-golden-map fully loads e3t1 in ~11s and is the default for workbench loops.
Headless Chromium needs --use-gl=angle for GPU rendering (software WebGL renders at ~6 fps and stalls material upgrades).
Known pre-existing render quirks at kugane-castle baseline: floating stair/roof slabs over water planes, flat water shading; recorded, not fixed in this task.

S02.title: 问题现场快照与恢复
S02.entry: wb.mjs --command=case.capture [--args='{"caseId":"..."}'] ; case.restore accepts {caseId} or inline {case} with optional semantics=strict|compatible
S02.verification: 7/7 steps pass: capture (2 stable objects) -> save -> scramble (camera/night/pause) -> restore complete -> read-back matches; strict semantics reject stale assetRunId (version-mismatch); missing object address -> partial restore with explicit missing list; visual review confirms HUD camera/time identical to case
knownGaps: cross-map restore (accepted + sessionStorage pending apply) implemented but exercised only implicitly; weather field is a placeholder until S04 adds real overrides

S03.title: 对象检查与资源溯源
S03.verification: 6/6 steps pass: full chain from stable address -> instance worldMatrix/spatialCell -> model resourceId+contentHash (33 sibling placements) -> material path/shader/workflow (bg.shpk, background-packed-mask-dielectric, confirmed channel semantics) -> texture slots (content-hash resourceIds, gamma flags, uv scales) -> Babylon final params; sibling instance same model different address/transform; stable address survives page reload; whoUses counts + representatives
knownGaps: observed: albedo texture reports gammaSpace=linear in the current pipeline (albedo is a color channel); surfaced to the visual-replication task, not changed here
whoUses covers model instances and manifest.materials presence only; bundle-level reverse index comes with S09

S04.title: 参数编辑与补丁落盘
S04.verification: 11/11 steps pass: shared-material mutation rejected without explicit acknowledgement (33 users); instance scope clones the master mesh (instanced meshes render the master material) and observes the new value; undo/redo restore and reapply; environment exposure override observed through a rendered frame; patch export -> clear -> page reload -> re-import reproduces identical values; stale assetRunId patch refused (version-mismatch)
knownGaps: patch re-import onto an already-overridden session overwrites values without deep conflict diffing (base values are compared only against the asset version)
environment overrides cover exposure/fog/ambient/sun only; saved presets layer (shared across sessions) is deferred until S07 recipes need it

S05.title: 局部热更新与失败回退
S05.entry: wb.mjs --command=hot.updateMaterial --args='{"stableAddress":"...","change":{"kind":"texture","slot":"albedo","runtimePath":"textures/0051.webp"}}' ; kinds: texture | shader(preset broken/flat); hot.rollback restores previous binding
S05.verification: 8/8 steps pass: environment numeric change without any reload; texture-reference rebind on an isolated clone with rollback restoring the exact previous binding; deliberately broken shader candidate never becomes ready -> rejected (candidate-rejected) with the previous material still bound; valid flat ShaderMaterial replaces then rolls back; material/texture/mesh growth bounded (<=4/<=8/<=2) across all rounds; generation counter supersedes stale in-flight updates
knownGaps: hot.updateMaterial has no generation collision test in the loop (needs concurrent dispatches); the guard is exercised only indirectly
layer-3 candidates are diagnostic presets (broken/flat), not a production shader pipeline; Vite HMR still covers module code while the workbench owns resource lifecycle

S06.title: 单对象隔离实验室
S06.entry: wb.mjs --command=isolate.enter --args='{"stableAddress":"e3t1:118:0"}' ; isolate.env {mode: neutral|original} ; isolate.exit returns the saved site
S06.verification: 7/7 steps pass: enter hides all other meshes (visible <= 12) and reports dependency changes (shadows/fog/neighbours); neutral<->original env toggle; orbit rig moves the camera around object bounds; wireframe on the isolated clone; independent instance override + undo inside isolation; exit re-enables the scene (enabled mesh count restored within 2) and returns the exact camera/time site
knownGaps: opening a raw resource sample without its map is UNSUPPORTED this round (needs a second scene wired to the same AssetRuntime); isolation is selection-based only
character/animation isolation not exercised in viewer mode (no character runtime in the map-only viewer); remains a full-client task
